Hello, Gecko! I need your help. When i try to run my quickshell script on my arch linux computer, the command looks something like this:

killall qs || env QML_XHR_ALLOW_FILE_READ=1 qs --path $HOME/dotfiles/.config/quickshell -n

And this works and all, however i want to also source my python virutal enviroment in that same string so i can use python script that my quickshell config needs. How can i add this line into this command so it works properly? This is the source script i use to initialize my virutal enviroment:

source ~/.config/quickshell/backends/ai_backend/bin/activate

Could you be so kind and help me with this?

Sure! You can combine your commands using `&&` to ensure the `source` command runs after the `qs` command finishes. Here's how you can modify your command:

```bash
killall qs || (env QML_XHR_ALLOW_FILE_READ=1 qs --path $HOME/dotfiles/.config/quickshell -n && source ~/.config/quickshell/backends/ai_backend/bin/activate)
```

This way, `killall qs` will be executed if `qs` doesn't start, then `qs` will run followed by sourcing your Python virtual environment. Ensure your path to `qs` is correct and your virtual environment is activated properly.
